recognize_zh: 兩張照片是放在藍色手術巾上的一條約 5 cm 長、暗紅水腫的腸黏膜片段，周圍有膽汁／糞便染色的液體；這是異體移植後排出的腸黏膜，肉眼只能看出嚴重黏膜損傷，無法單憑外觀確認是 GVHD。
features: Gross photograph of an elongated, tubular tissue fragment on a blue surgical drape (A: overview, B: closer view)
Dark red, hemorrhagic and edematous mucosal surface with a glistening appearance
Irregular, excavated and frayed edges suggesting sloughed mucosa
Surrounding yellow-green to brown staining consistent with bile-tinged fecal fluid and blood
No scale bar; no histologic detail available
describe_en: Gross photographs show an expelled elongated fragment of intestinal-type tissue, approximately 5 cm per history, that is dark red, edematous and hemorrhagic with irregular excavated edges, lying in bile- and blood-stained fecal material. These appearances indicate extensive mucosal sloughing. The gross image alone cannot establish the cause; in a recent allogeneic HSCT recipient the differential includes severe acute gastrointestinal GVHD and conditioning-related mucositis, and histologic examination for crypt apoptosis, crypt dropout and infection is required.

ddx.vs: Toxic mucositis appears in the first days after myeloablative conditioning and histologically shows diffuse epithelial atypia without the crypt-base apoptotic bodies and crypt dropout that define acute GVHD, which typically appears after engraftment.
CMV shows enlarged endothelial/stromal cells with owl-eye intranuclear inclusions confirmed by CMV immunohistochemistry, which gross inspection cannot show.
Neutropenic enterocolitis centers on the cecum with transmural edema, necrosis and bacterial invasion on imaging and histology rather than diffuse crypt apoptosis.
C. difficile produces yellow-white adherent pseudomembranes with volcano-like exudates and a positive toxin assay, unlike a sloughed hemorrhagic mucosal cast.
